ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $O$ is the circumcircle of $\triangle ABC$, $AB$ is the diameter of $O$, $AB \perp CD$ at point $E$, and $P$ is a point on the extension line of $AB$, with $\angle BCP = \angle BCD$. Extend $DO$ to intersect $AC$ at point $F$ and intersect $O$ at point $G$, and connect $GC$. Given that the radius of $O$ is $5$ and $OE=3$, find the lengths of $GC$ and $OF$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AB\perp CD$ at point E, \\
hence E is the midpoint of CD, \\
Since O is the midpoint of GD, \\
hence OE is the median of $\triangle DCG$, \\
hence $GC=2OE=6$, $OE\parallel GC$, \\
Since $AO\parallel GC$, \\
hence $\triangle GCF\sim \triangle OAF$, \\
hence $\frac{GC}{OA}=\frac{GF}{OF}$, \\
that is $\frac{6}{5}=\frac{GF}{OF}$, \\
Since $GF+OF=5$, \\
hence $OF=\boxed{\frac{25}{11}}$.

method.method_draft: Synthetic midpoint-and-similarity route. First read the diagram: AB is the horizontal diameter through center O, E lies on AB to the right of O, CD is the vertical chord through E with C above and D below, DO is extended through O to meet the circle again at G, F is the intersection of line DG with AC, and segment GC is drawn. Since D and G are opposite endpoints of the diameter through O, O is the midpoint of DG. In triangle DCG, EO joins the midpoints of DC and DG, so EO is a midline: EO parallel GC and GC=2·OE=6. Because OA lies on AB and EO lies on AB, OA is also parallel to GC. With F on AC and DG, triangles GCF and OAF are similar using GC∥OA, CF collinear with AF, and GF collinear with OF. Thus GC/OA=GF/OF=6/5. Since OG is a radius, OG=5, and from the diagram F lies between O and G, so GF+OF=5. Solve GF/OF=6/5 with GF+OF=5 to get OF=25/11. Therefore GC=6 and OF=25/11.

图像描述：图中可见一条水平直线从左到右经过 A、O、E、B，并继续延长到 P；O 是圆心，AB 是圆的水平直径。点 E 在 O 的右侧，过 E 有一条竖直线 CD，与 AB 垂直，C 在上方、D 在下方，直角标记画在 E 附近。直线 DO 延长后经过 O 并与圆再交于 G，且该直线与 AC 交于 F，图中还连接了 GC。

推理：因为 AB 是过圆心 O 的直径所在直线，且 AB⊥CD 于 E，所以垂径定理给出 E 是弦 CD 的中点。又因为 D、G 是过圆心 O 的同一直径两端点，所以 O 是 DG 的中点。在三角形 DCG 中，E 是 DC 的中点，O 是 DG 的中点，因此 EO 是三角形 DCG 的中位线，所以 EO∥GC，且 GC=2·OE。已知 OE=3，所以 GC=6。

又因为 OA 与 OE 都在直线 AB 上，而 EO∥GC，所以 OA∥GC。点 F 在 AC 上，也在 DG 上，因此 CF 与 AF 共线，GF 与 OF 共线。由 OA∥GC，可得 △GCF∼△OAF。于是对应边成比例：GC/OA=GF/OF。圆的半径为 5，所以 OA=5；已求 GC=6，因此 GF/OF=6/5。图中 F 位于 O 与 G 之间，且 OG 为半径，OG=5，所以 GF+OF=5。设 OF=x，则 GF=5-x，(5-x)/x=6/5，解得 25-5x=6x，11x=25，因此 OF=25/11。

method.method_draft: Coordinate-geometry route. Read from the diagram that AB is a horizontal diameter with O at its midpoint, E is to the right of O on AB, and CD is the vertical chord through E with C on the upper arc and D on the lower arc; line DO meets the circle again at G and meets AC at F. From the text read radius 5 and OE=3. Put O=(0,0), AB on the x-axis, A=(-5,0), B=(5,0). Since E is 3 units to the right of O, take E=(3,0). The chord CD is vertical, so its points on the circle x^2+y^2=25 have x=3, giving y=±4. Thus C=(3,4) and D=(3,-4). The line DO passes through the origin and D, so its second intersection with the circle is G=(-3,4). Then GC is the horizontal distance from x=-3 to x=3, so GC=6. To find F, write line AC through A(-5,0) and C(3,4): y=(x+5)/2. Line DO has equation y=-(4/3)x. Solving (x+5)/2=-(4/3)x gives x=-15/11 and y=20/11, so F=(-15/11,20/11). Hence OF=sqrt((15/11)^2+(20/11)^2)=25/11. Therefore GC=6 and OF=25/11.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中可以看出 AB 是一条水平直线，A 在左侧，B 在右侧，O 位于 AB 上且在 A、B 之间；P 在 B 的右侧延长线上。点 E 在 O 的右侧、B 的左侧，过 E 有一条竖直线 CD，且图中标有直角符号表示 AB ⟂ CD。C 在上方，D 在下方；线 DO 向上延长与圆再交于 G，并与 AC 相交于 F，且连接了 GC。

推理：按坐标法设 O=(0,0)，AB 为 x 轴。圆 O 的半径为 5，所以圆方程为 x^2+y^2=25，且 A=(-5,0)，B=(5,0)。由图和题意 OE=3，且 E 在 O 右侧，所以 E=(3,0)。因为 CD 垂直 AB，是过 E 的竖直弦，所以 C、D 的横坐标都是 3。代入圆方程得 3^2+y^2=25，即 y^2=16，所以 y=±4。结合图中 C 在上、D 在下，取 C=(3,4)，D=(3,-4)。

直线 DO 过 O=(0,0) 和 D=(3,-4)，其方程为 y=-(4/3)x。该直线与圆的另一个交点与 D 关于 O 对称，所以 G=(-3,4)。因此 GC 是从 x=-3 到 x=3 的水平距离，GC=6。

再求 F。直线 AC 过 A=(-5,0) 和 C=(3,4)，斜率为 4/8=1/2，所以方程为 y=(x+5)/2。F 是 AC 与 DO 的交点，解方程 (x+5)/2=-(4/3)x，得 3x+15=-8x，11x=-15，所以 x=-15/11；代回得 y=20/11。因此 F=(-15/11,20/11)。于是 OF=sqrt((-15/11)^2+(20/11)^2)=sqrt(225+400)/11=25/11。

所以 GC=6，OF=25/11。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, $O$ is the circumcircle of $\triangle ABC$, $AB$ is the diameter of $O$, $AB \perp CD$ at point $E$, and $P$ is a point on the extension line of $AB$, with $\angle BCP = \angle BCD$. Extend $DO$ to intersect $AC$ at point $F$ and intersect $O$ at point $G$, and connect $GC$. Given that the radius of $O$ is $5$ and $OE=3$, find the lengths of $GC$ and $OF$.
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AB\perp CD$ at point E, \\
hence E is the midpoint of CD, \\
Since O is the midpoint of GD, \\
hence OE is the median of $\triangle DCG$, \\
hence $GC=2OE=6$, $OE\parallel GC$, \\
Since $AO\parallel GC$, \\
hence $\triangle GCF\sim \triangle OAF$, \\
hence $\frac{GC}{OA}=\frac{GF}{OF}$, \\
that is $\frac{6}{5}=\frac{GF}{OF}$, \\
Since $GF+OF=5$, \\
hence $OF=\boxed{\frac{25}{11}}$
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, a horizontal straight line can be seen passing through A, O, E, B from left to right, and continuing to extend to P; O is the center of the circle, and AB is the horizontal diameter of the circle. Point E is on the right side of O, and through E there is a vertical line CD, perpendicular to AB, with C above and D below, and the right-angle mark drawn near E. After line DO is extended, it passes through O and intersects the circle again at G, and this line intersects AC at F; GC is also connected in the figure.

Reasoning: Because AB is the line on which the diameter through the center O lies, and AB⊥CD at E, the perpendicular bisector theorem for chords gives that E is the midpoint of chord CD. Also because D and G are the two endpoints of the same diameter passing through the center O, O is the midpoint of DG. In triangle DCG, E is the midpoint of DC, and O is the midpoint of DG, therefore EO is the midline of triangle DCG, so EO∥GC, and GC=2·OE. It is known that OE=3, so GC=6.

Also because OA and OE are both on line AB, and EO∥GC, so OA∥GC. Point F is on AC and also on DG, therefore CF and AF are collinear, and GF and OF are collinear. From OA∥GC, we can get △GCF∼△OAF. Thus corresponding sides are proportional: GC/OA=GF/OF. The radius of the circle is 5, so OA=5; GC has already been found to be 6, therefore GF/OF=6/5. In the figure, F is located between O and G, and OG is a radius, OG=5, so GF+OF=5. Let OF=x, then GF=5-x, (5-x)/x=6/5, solving gives 25-5x=6x, 11x=25, therefore OF=25/11.
